notes: v1.0.16 — V2 engineering & quality pass. (1) Human-readable time everywhere: 5m / 15h 4m / 1d 8h 6m (playtime, toasts, ETA). (2) Real download queue with concurrency 1/3/5 (default 1) — click Install on several items and they queue; Downloads page shows real speed, sizes and ETA. (3) Update All now always asks for confirmation and lists current → new versions; updates stay strictly manual. (4) Launching vs Playing state is now accurate — no false Launching. (5) Removing any mod/pack/shader (and clearing logs) asks for confirmation; hold SHIFT to skip it. (6) Settings reorganized into fewer logical categories with a live search that jumps to the setting. (7) Check for Updates button with live states. (8) UI scale option removed — always 100% logical scale, responsive layout. (9) Reimagined FPS Boost is now removable and reinstallable from the Installed header (and never silently reappears). (10) Crash Assistant is structured and evidence-based: real exception, root cause, responsible mods, pre-crash log tail, confidence level, Copy Log + Copy Crash Report; new Sodium↔Iris fence-crash diagnosis. (11) Instance content is verified against the filesystem — no ghost mods. Minecraft settings are never touched by installs/updates.
